name: Tooltip Group
description: Toolbar tooltips with real timing: a 400 ms rest to open, instant close, and one surface that glides between neighbours. Keycaps, a tracking arrow and collision flips.
usage:
import { TooltipGroup, Tooltip } from "@/components/design-for-ai/tooltip-group"; // The group owns the timing and the one floating surface, and is the collision boundary.
// Tooltips render inside the group (no portal). To escape a clipping parent, render the group high in the tree // (for example around the whole editor) so it is a large enough boundary, or lift the surface to document.body.

props.name: children
props.description: Triggers wrapped in <Tooltip label shortcut>, plus any other content. The group's box is the collision boundary.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long the pointer must rest on a cold trigger before its tooltip opens, in ms.

props.name: skipDelay
props.description: How long the group stays warm after a tooltip closes, so a neighbour opens instantly.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side. A tooltip that would leave the group flips to the opposite side and shifts along the other axis.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Draws an arrow that keeps pointing at the centre of its trigger, even when the tooltip shifts to fit.

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Shows each Tooltip's shortcut as keycaps.

props.name: offset
props.description: Space between the trigger and the tooltip, on top of the arrow, in px.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Closest a tooltip may sit to the group's edge before it shifts or flips, in px.

props.name: defaultActive
props.description: A Tooltip id to show once on mount, as if hovered. The first pointer or focus in the group takes over.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the group sits on, so the tooltip's hairline and shadow keep their contrast.

props.name: onTimingEvent
props.description: Every timing decision: wait, cancel, open (with why: delay, skip, focus, press or pinned, and the side it landed on) and close.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the group's root, which is position: relative.

props.name: Tooltip.label
props.description: On each <Tooltip>: what the trigger does, in two or three words.

props.name: Tooltip.shortcut
props.description: On each <Tooltip>: keys as printed, e.g. ["⌘", "⇧", "X"]. Also sets aria-keyshortcuts on the trigger.
